positions.title: Independent Consultant, Open Source Software Engineer, Meta Researcher
positions.description:
@westurner
https://github.com/westurner
https://westurner.org/ ( westurner.github.io )

https://westurner.org/resume
https://westurner.org/wiki/projects
https://westurner.org/wiki/contributions

https://westurner.org/tools

- Systems: Linux Containers, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes (OpenShift has per-container SELinux security contexts), x64, ARM64

- Networking: OpenWRT, CGI, RJ-45, CAT-6, VLANs

- Frontend UI: JS, React+Redux, Bootstrap, TypeScript

- Backend Web Development: HTTP/3 API, WebSockets, Python, Django, Jinja2 HTML templates, Pyramid, Flask, Django REST Framework, django-rest-assured, Tornado, uvloop asyncio, JAMstack

- JupyterLab, repo2docker, BinderHub

- YAML, JSON-LD, CSVW, RDF, SQLite recursive CTE, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, ElasticSearch, SQLalchemy, PyArrow (Data represented in the Parquet file format loads from disk to RAM extremely quickly due to the file layout being the same as the memory layout (without compression or sparse coding), but tools don't yet have support for linked data schema with URIs. A spreadsheet is a projection of a graph: a column maps to an rdfs:Property (which may have multiple attributes in addition to the standard column label: URI, datatype URI, physical unit URI, accuracy, precision, property path), and a row is an instance of an rdfs:Class (or properties of one or more subject URIs which may have types) hopefully with an index at least on a unique surrogate or possibly natural key.)

- Data Science/ML/AI: SciPy Stack: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, AutoML, Dask-ML, dask-labextension, symbolic functions with parameters and operators; cost and fitness

https://westurner.org/wiki/workflow

- 3 Questions: Since, Before, Obstacles

- Collaboration Engineering; 7 Layer Model: Goals, Products, Patterns, Techniques, Tools, Scripts; 6 Patterns: Generate, Reduce, Clarify, Organize, Evaluate, Build Consensus

https://wrdrd.com/docs/ ( wrdrd.github.io )

positions.description:
https://www.unmc.edu/

1. Contributed to iterative releases of a Web-based Computerized Provider Order Entry System for the UNMC Internal Medicine Department of Cardiology Knowledge Engineering Group .

2. Employed aspects of Scrum Agile/Lean development methodology .

3. Created internal development environment to enable collaboration and  continuous integration .

Technologies: Python, Zope, LaTeX, AMQP, Javascript, YUI, Trac, Agilo, Mercurial

Interests: EHR APIs and Interoperability, Semantic Web, ETL, Inference, Cloud Provisioning, Schema Versioning

https://westurner.org/resume/html/resume.html#programmer-analyst-i-unmc

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
https://nucia.unomaha.edu

1. Directed team of three in designing, developing, and producing a custom Content Management System to boost  enrollment and reciprocate for investor relations

2. Coded custom content management system replete with RSS, iCal, and streaming video

3. Built and maintained internal development environment to enable team collaboration

4. Developed blueprint to increase integrity and availability by overhauling a series of intranet services onto a virtualized appliance platform

5. Contributed platform to penetration testing course

6. Fielded and prioritised tasks and features in Trac

7. Lead biweekly project review meetings with senior faculty

Technologies: Python, Django Web Framework, Javascript, Dojo, Plone, Zope, MySQL, Snort, Jabber, VPN, Trac,  Subversion

positions.title: Web Consultant
positions.description:
1. Integrated, search engine optimized, and styled custom Content Management / Customer Relationship Management solution

2. Increased web leads by 30% in the first quarter of operation

3. Enabled targeted marketing and sales with Google Analytics

Technologies: Python, Django, PHP, vTiger, MySQL
